Start here

You’re already welcome on the porch. This page is the quick doorway into the fuller Explore start-here map; you’ll be taken there automatically in a moment. Scripture on the site is KJV unless a translated mood page says otherwise. Plan checkmarks, wall lines, and most notes stay on this device until you sign in or print on purpose. Nothing here is grading you.

If you only read one line and rest, you are not behind—come back when you want a next click. No pressure if today is only quiet.

Start on Home

  • Ask The Word — type a question, a battle, or how you are doing (or tap a topic chip). Verses line up with your words; what you type stays on your device.
  • Verse of the Day — a steady anchor when you do not want to search.
  • Quick topics — the calm category cards and chips (peace, fear, hope, and the rest) are the fastest way in.
Open Home Verse of the Day

One quiet minute

  • Calm — one verse, minimal chrome.
  • Daily Rhythm (Morning & Evening) — a gentle morning order: verse, calm, one plan day, prayer starters, optional chapter reading.
  • Möbius Loop — endless grace, returning always to the cross: a calm ribbon when battles loop (graph, breath, private journal).
  • One Family in Christ — unity from the same Father: Adam to Jesus, tap names for KJV verses, witnesses, and adoption in Christ (works offline).
  • Red letters — rest in the Saviour’s own words: optional red speech in Matthew–John; one toggle on your device, no commentary added.
  • Come Unto Me — five quiet days when your own words fail; only the Saviour’s words (KJV).
  • Only His Voice — five days, only the Lord Jesus’s speech (KJV red letters; no other voices).
  • When Fear Presses In — gentle Scripture for anxious hearts; His voice and sure promises (KJV). Only His Voice for pure red letters.
  • Life Lessons from the Word — sixteen Scripture-soaked lessons (start with God Provides in the Worry); searchable by topic; print sheets; optional return bookmark, no score.
  • Porch update email template — copy-ready note for your list (Red-Letters plans + Life Lessons); adapt before sending.
  • The Road to Salvation — five quiet gospel days for anyone wondering how to come to Christ (KJV, no test at the end).
  • Gifts from the Father of Lights — five slow days noticing what He has already given (pairs with the heritage tree and thanks seasons).
  • What God has done — private journal on this device; short dated entries, optional export. No posting.

Stay in the Word

  • Battle Plans — multi-day tracks: one verse, plain words, a step, a prayer; progress saves on your device.
  • Chapter reader — full chapters in order; good when you want context, not snippets. Tap Study on a verse for a KJV word list (whole Bible on device once loaded).
  • Memorize — verse cards, gentle spaced review, typing and listening practice; private on this device (no streaks).
  • Bible tool — look up passages and words; save lines to My Study.
  • Psalms hub — comfort, praise, and family Psalms plans in one place.

Pray with quiet company

  • Prayer — short anonymous lines; tap the heart for a silent amen.
  • Pray with others — when you need a bit more room to write.

Family, kids, and paper

  • Family hub — verse, plans doorway, printables index.
  • Marriage, family & home — structured plans for the household.
  • Kids Corner — stories and activities for shorter attention spans.
  • Printables hub — One Week of Quiet Rhythm, verse cards, calm sheets, family packs, and more.

New or returning to faith?

If you are asking about faith itself, not where to click, start with First steps in faith and Who God says you are. Those pages are a doorway, not a site map.
